chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Jaʿfar asked his brother Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar, peace be upon him, about a man whose garment fell upon a dead dog. He said:
He should sprinkle it with water and pray in it, and there is no harm.
ai.seo_question: What should a person do if his clothing touches a dead dog?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about clothing that came into contact with a dead dog. It states that the garment should be sprinkled with water, and salat (prayer) in it is permissible without objection.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.169 - Ali ibn Ja'far asked his brother Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as) about a man whose clothing comes into contact with a dead dog.
Imam (as) replied: 'He should sprinkle it with water and may pray in it, and there is no issue.'.
